a: Students in identified Beast Philanthropy partner communities in Ghana who stay enrolled and successfully pass their standardized 9th grade exams.
It closes the financial gap at the most fragile moment, the transition from junior high into senior high school, covering the start-up costs that otherwise force capable students out of education.
Students who are enrolled in school and pass their standardized 9th grade exams are eligible to receive the scholarship.

All program design, eligibility, and distribution decisions are made by the experienced team on the ground. Distributions are kept deliberately simple and are reviewed on a regular cycle, with safeguards and follow-up so support is used to further a child's education and wellbeing.
